# Callouts: Recovery 4b - the ESP32 recorder: both J29 holes, the rails, flash chip select

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~229 px/mm)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/rec4b_wiring.jpg](../../../images/annotated/rec4b_wiring.jpg)

Strap off. Every line into the ESP32 through its resistor or divider; the ESP32 on USB with its 5V and 3V3 pins unconnected. Supply on JP5.

| 2 | JP5.2 | JP5 pin 2, GND |  | Power | confirmed | The round pad above pin 1, '2' printed left of it; GND, the same net as U15 pin 4. Also ESP32 GND. |

| 8 | J8 | J8: cable OUT |  | Connector | confirmed | The FFC stays out of J8 in every bench session: the board gets its power on JP5 only. |
